title: WireTest

AntigravityHarnessDescriptor.description: The Antigravity CLI through `@reeval/harness-antigravity`, made by `antigravity()`.

effort.description: Reasoning effort passed as `agy --effort`, e.g. `low`, `medium`, `high` or `max`. The slug's `-low`/`-medium`/`-high` suffix is the same knob baked into `model`.

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `antigravity:<model>`, or `antigravity:<model>[effort=<value>]` when `effort` is set.

maxConcurrent.description: The most Antigravity attempts at once, across the run, e.g. for the key's rate limits.

model.description: A model slug `agy models` lists for a Gemini API key, e.g. `gemini-3.8-flash-medium`.

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

AttemptMeta.description: Set when an attempt is registered, so the reporter has it even for skipped attempts.

brokered.description: The secrets this attempt brokers, as `NAME → host, host`.

family.description: Set when the eval is a case of a pooled `evaluate.each`.

files.description: The paths its environment's `files` write, layered and sorted; unset when there are none.

gate.description: How its cell's attempts decide the cell's outcome; `'none'` when they don't fail the run.

label.description: The harness, then the role (with `compare`), plus `#n` when it has several runs.

minLift.description: Set on variant attempts whose compare has a `minLift`.

secretVars.description: The host variables its secrets read, by name: the CLI's own process masks their values on screen, since the attempt's worker is the only other process that knows them.

setBy.description: The levels that set its sandbox and harness: `reeval.config.ts`, `profiles.pr.defaults`, `group("net")` or `evaluate("x")`.

skip.description: Why this attempt does not run, e.g. it already completed in a resumed run.

workspace.description: The git repository its workspace starts as, which the CLI fetches before any attempt.

CaptureOptions.description: Camera defaults for `c.capture()`. Cascades config → profile defaults → group → eval, shallow-merged. `viewport` on a level replaces the whole value. `port` is not an option: pass it as the first argument to `c.capture`.

browser.description: `false` refuses the host `chrome-headless-shell` binary. `c.capture()` then throws.

model.description: Vision model for `instructions`. Cascades like `question`. Default is the analysis model when that model accepts images; never Jev.

timeout.description: How long to poll before failing. Default `'60s'`.

CaptureWindow.description: Live tab size for `c.capture()`. Default 1280×720 when the call and cascade omit `viewport`.

Cell.description: One cell of an eval: a harness, an environment (`-` when none is set) and that environment's image (`sandbox` id: tag, dockerfile and install). With `compare`, the control is `baseline` (or the cascaded environment, or an empty `baseline`) and each variant is that environment on its own, including its sandbox.

variant.description: The variant's name, for variant cells.

CellGate.description: A cell's gate: its policy, or `'none'` when its failures don't fail the eval (a control's).

effort.description: Reasoning effort the Agent SDK `/effort` control takes: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` (Extra in the UI) or `max`.

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `claude-code:<model>`, or `claude-code:<model>[effort=<value>]` when `effort` is set.

maxConcurrent.description: The most Claude Code attempts at once, across the run, e.g. for the account's rate limits.

model.description: A model id or alias the `claude` CLI accepts, e.g. `claude-sonnet-5` or `sonnet`.

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

CodexHarnessDescriptor.description: OpenAI's Codex CLI through `@reeval/harness-codex` (`codex exec --json`), made by `codex()`. It runs OpenAI models on an OpenAI API key and reports each turn's tokens, reasoning included.

effort.description: Reasoning effort as Codex's `model_reasoning_effort`, e.g. `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max` or `ultra`.

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `codex:<model>`, or `codex:<model>[effort=<value>]` when `effort` is set.

maxConcurrent.description: The most Codex attempts at once, across the run, e.g. for the key's rate limits.

model.description: An OpenAI model id Codex runs on the Responses API, e.g. `gpt-5.6-luna`.

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

CursorHarnessDescriptor.description: Cursor's agent through the Cursor TypeScript SDK's local runtime (`@reeval/harness-cursor-sdk`), made by `cursor()`. It reports each turn's tokens.

effort.description: Reasoning effort, mapped onto the catalog param `Cursor.models.list()` names for this model (`reasoning_effort`, `effort`, …). Not Fast: that stays `params.fast`.

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `cursor:<model>`, or `cursor:<model>[effort=<value>]` when `effort` is set.

maxConcurrent.description: The most Cursor attempts at once, across the run, e.g. for the account's rate limits.

model.description: A model id `Cursor.models.list()` returns for the key, e.g. `composer-2.5`.

params.description: Model parameters, e.g. `{ fast: 'false' }`. Unset ones take the default variant in Cursor's model catalog (`fast=true` for `composer-2.5`), sent explicitly; pass the ones that change cost.

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

capabilities.description: Linux capabilities to add back, e.g. `['NET_RAW']`; every other one is dropped.

cpus.description: CPUs the container may use, fractions allowed. Default 2, capped at the Docker host's.

dockerfile.description: An absolute path to a Dockerfile (`docker()` resolves it against the calling file), built from its directory with `REEVAL_BASE` set to reeval's sandbox image and cached by content hash.

from.description: A Debian or Ubuntu based toolchain image; reeval bakes Node and the harness on top, cached.

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `docker`, or `docker:<image>` for other images, plus an install hash.

image.description: An image that already has the harness baked in, used as is.

install.description: Baked onto the sandbox image in one build container: in order, no secrets, no workspace.

maxConcurrent.description: The most Docker sandboxes at once, across the run, whatever their image.

pids.description: Processes and threads at once. Default 1024.

root.description: Run the agent, setup steps and checks as root, with the capabilities `apt-get` needs, instead of the unprivileged `reeval` user. For evals that install system packages at run time.

swap.description: Swap on top of `memory`, in the same units. Default: as much as `memory`; `0` makes `memory` the hard ceiling. A host without swap has none to give.

EgressPolicy.description: Where the sandbox may connect: anywhere (`'allow-all'`, the default), nowhere (`'deny-all'`), or only the listed hosts (`'*.example.com'` matches subdomains). Under a restricted policy the harness's own hosts, brokered secrets' `hosts` and MCP servers' hosts are allowed too; any other request gets a refusal, and the attempt goes on.

EvalCompareMeta.description: Which environment ran as the control, so the studio can show it.

from.description: Set when `compare.baseline` was omitted: the control is the eval's cascaded `environment`, or an empty environment named `baseline` when there was none.

EvalPlan.description: How an eval was sized for the plan: what it asked for, and what a profile changed.

brokered.description: Secrets any of its attempts brokers, as `NAME → host, host`.

capture.description: Resolved camera defaults when any field is set.

compare.description: Set when the eval compares variant cells.

egress.description: Each distinct restricted egress policy its attempts run under, as the plan prints it.

gate.description: The eval's gate policy, or undefined when it was left at the default (`'all'`).

questions.description: The compare's questions, answered after the run; unset without any, or when a profile dropped them.

sandboxWarnings.description: Its sandbox runs as root or with capabilities added back; empty for a skipped eval.

skip.description: Why the eval doesn't run at all, e.g. a profile's harness limit left none.

variants.description: Variants run, of those the eval compares; null without `compare`.

warnings.description: Warnings about the eval's setup, e.g. a moving git ref.

workspaces.description: Each distinct git workspace its attempts start from, as `repo#ref:path`.

delayMs.description: Simulated turn length, honours the abort signal.

effort.description: Requested reasoning effort, recorded as `effort` on the cell. Use `servedModel` for what the turn reports (`fake-1[effort=medium]`). Fast is not this.

failWith.description: Throw before the first turn starts, to simulate an infra failure.

files.description: Files the fake agent writes into the sandbox on every turn.

flakeRate.description: Chance (0–1) that an attempt writes no files and says so, for flaky pass rates.

ignoreAbort.description: Sits out `delayMs` even after an abort, like an agent that doesn't stop when it's told to.

layout.description: Behave like this agent: its image, and where it reads rules and skills (`CLAUDE.md` and `.claude/skills` for `claude-code`, `~/.gemini/config/skills` for `antigravity`, `~/.config/opencode/skills` for `opencode`, Goose's private home for `goose`, `~/.pi/agent/skills` for `pi`, `~/.agents/skills` for `codex`). Defaults to the fake's own (`AGENTS.md`, `.agents/skills`) in Cursor's image.

maxConcurrent.description: The most attempts on this harness kind at once, across the run.

reasoning.description: A reasoning block at the start of every turn.

script.description: Real sandbox actions, one list per `c.send` (the last list repeats), run in order before `files`. `exec` runs as the agent: with the sandbox's own variables, none of the checks'.

servedModel.description: The model the fake agent says served each turn, as a real harness reports its resolved model and variant (`composer-2.5[fast=true]`); unset, it reports none.

startHangs.description: The first this many session starts of an attempt never become ready, even when aborted (`true`: every one).

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

tools.description: Tool calls the fake agent reports on every turn, before writing files.

withSkill.description: Files and message used instead when the environment gives the agent a skill.

dir.description: Parent directory for the per-eval workspace (defaults to the OS temp dir).

maxConcurrent.description: The most attempts on this sandbox kind at once, across the run.

FakeScriptStep.description: One action of a scripted fake agent. `exec` is reported as a `shell` tool call whose output is the command's stdout, `write` as file edits, and `reply` is the turn's final message. `mcp` (`'<server>/<tool>'`) starts the environment's stdio MCP server in the sandbox, as an agent would, and calls the tool with no arguments; it's reported as `mcp__<server>__<tool>`. `error` ends the turn there with status `error` and that message, as a provider error would.

FamilyMeta.description: A case's place in its pooled `evaluate.each`.

case.description: This case's index in the list, from 0.

cases.description: How many cases the list has.

id.description: `file › group › … › template`, like an eval id with the name template in place of the name.

GitWorkspace.description: A git repository (or one directory of it) the workspace starts as, from the `git` helper. `url` is what reeval fetches: the clone URL, or an absolute path for a local repository.

init.description: Give the workspace a `.git`: one commit of the fetched tree, with no remote.

path.description: A directory in the repository whose contents become the workspace.

ref.description: A branch, tag or commit SHA; unset is the remote's `HEAD`.

repo.description: As written: a URL, `github:owner/repo`, or a local path.

token.description: The host variable holding a token for the fetch; read on the host only.

GooseHarnessDescriptor.description: Goose through `@reeval/harness-goose` (`goose acp`), made by `goose()`. It runs Google models on a Gemini API key, and reports no usage (its ACP server counts one call).

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `goose:<model>`, or `goose:<model>[effort=<value>]` when `effort` is set.

maxConcurrent.description: The most Goose attempts at once, across the run, e.g. for the key's rate limits.

model.description: A Gemini model id, run on Goose's `google` provider, e.g. `gemini-3.8-flash`.

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

InstallStep.description: A `docker({ install })` command, baked into a cached image layer: no secrets, root, cwd `/`.

OpenCodeHarnessDescriptor.description: OpenCode through `@reeval/harness-opencode` (`opencode acp`), made by `opencode()`. It runs on any provider whose key OpenCode sends in a header on known hosts, with that provider's key, and reports no usage (its ACP server counts one call).

effort.description: Reasoning effort for that provider: `options.reasoningEffort` (OpenAI) or `options.thinking` (Anthropic). Values are whatever that provider takes.

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `opencode:<model>`, or `opencode:<model>[effort=<value>]` when `effort` is set.

maxConcurrent.description: The most OpenCode attempts at once, across the run, e.g. for the key's rate limits.

model.description: OpenCode's model id, `<provider>/<model>`, e.g. `google/gemini-3.8-flash` or `anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5`; the provider picks the key.

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

PiHarnessDescriptor.description: pi through `@reeval/harness-pi` (`pi --mode json` in the sandbox), made by `pi()`. It runs Google models on a Gemini API key and reports each model call's tokens. It takes stdio and HTTP MCP servers, not SSE ones.

effort.description: Reasoning effort, passed as pi's `--thinking` (the CLI's name). Values are whatever that flag takes, e.g. `off`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` or `max`.

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `pi:<model>`, or `pi:<model>[effort=<value>]` when `effort` is set.

maxConcurrent.description: The most pi attempts at once, across the run, e.g. for the key's rate limits.

model.description: A Gemini model id, run on pi's `google` provider, e.g. `gemini-3.8-flash`.

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

PlannedEgress.description: An attempt's egress policy, and the hosts a restricted one allows on top of its own.

PlannedQuestion.description: A compare question as planned: its text, the model it names itself, if any, and the one factor it varies when it doesn't ask both pair kinds.

SandboxWarning.description: A sandbox with more privilege than the default `reeval` user: `docker({ root: true })`, or `docker({ capabilities })`. One per level that set such a sandbox, however many evals inherit it.

file.description: The eval file that sets it, for a group or eval; null for the config or a profile.

message.description: The line reeval prints, after `WARNING: ` (root) or `warning: ` (capabilities).

where.description: That level as reeval names it: `reeval.config.ts`, `profiles.pr.defaults`, `group("net")` or `evaluate("installs deps")`.

WireTest.description: What one registered test looks like to the main process.
